cap: The placenta has two halves. The fetal half is the chorion frondosum, villi bathed in maternal blood; the maternal half is the decidua basalis, which is also the plane along which the placenta separates after birth. Without it, as over a cesarean scar, villi reach the myometrium. Estriol takes three organs: fetal adrenal DHEA-S, fetal liver and placenta.
teach: Estriol is the one estrogen that reports on the fetus. The fetal adrenal cortex makes DHEA-S, the fetal liver hydroxylates it, and the placenta aromatizes it, so a failure at any link lowers maternal estriol; anencephaly removes the pituitary drive that keeps the fetal adrenal cortex large. Maternal adrenal DHEA-S becomes mostly estrone and estradiol and cannot replace it.
